description: Returns current conditions and the National Weather Service 7-day forecast for one US latitude and longitude as {source, location, current, forecast_updated, forecast, notes}: nearest-station temperature, humidity, wind and pressure, then up to 14 forecast periods with temperature, chance of precipitation, wind and a summary, usually in 1 to 3 seconds. US government data, public domain; US points only. A forecast is an estimate. Read-only. Paid per call with x402; outside the US or if the service is unavailable the call fails and is not charged.

lat.description: Latitude of a US point in decimal degrees, for example 32.78.
lat.title: Lat

lon.description: Longitude of a US point in decimal degrees, for example -96.80.
lon.title: Lon

name: weather.forecast

current.description: Latest nearest-station observation, or null if none could be read.

location.description: The point, nearest city and forecast office.
